entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may support reflective QoS functionality.

entities.name: Reflective QoS
entities.description: A quality of service mechanism where the UE derives uplink QoS rules from downlink traffic.

entities.name: PDU Session IPv4
entities.description: PDU session with IPv4 type where reflective QoS is applicable.

entities.name: PDU Session IPv6
entities.description: PDU session with IPv6 type where reflective QoS is applicable.

entities.name: PDU Session IPv4v6
entities.description: PDU session with IPv4v6 type where reflective QoS is applicable.

entities.name: PDU Session Ethernet
entities.description: PDU session with Ethernet type where reflective QoS is applicable.

entities.name: PDU Session Unstructured
entities.description: PDU session with Unstructured type where reflective QoS is not applicable.

entities.name: Control Plane Only Indication
entities.description: PDU session with control plane only indication where reflective QoS is not applicable.

entities.name: Revoke Reflective QoS
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests to stop using reflective QoS for an existing PDU session.

relations.description: UE may support reflective QoS functionality.
Reflective QoS is applicable in IPv4 PDU sessions.
Reflective QoS is applicable in IPv6 PDU sessions.
Reflective QoS is applicable in IPv4v6 PDU sessions.
Reflective QoS is applicable in Ethernet PDU sessions.
Reflective QoS is not applicable in Unstructured PDU sessions.
Reflective QoS is not applicable for PDU sessions with control plane only indication.
UE may request to revoke usage of reflective QoS for an existing PDU session.
